fun.en: Fuel of the stars — hydrogen fusion powers the Sun and releases 26 million kJ per gram.
fun.hr: Gorivo zvijezda — fuzija vodika pokreće Sunce i oslobađa 26 milijuna kJ po gramu.

fun.en: Discovered on the Sun before Earth — its name comes from Helios, the Greek sun god.
fun.hr: Otkriven na Suncu prije nego na Zemlji — ime dolazi od grčkog boga Sunca, Heliosa.

fun.en: Used in almost every rechargeable battery in your phone, laptop, and electric car.
fun.hr: Koristi se u gotovo svakoj punivoj bateriji u mobitelu, laptopu i električnom automobilu.

fun.en: Extremely toxic — chronic beryllium exposure causes berylliosis, a serious lung disease.
fun.hr: Iznimno otrovan — kronična izloženost beriliju uzrokuje beriliozu, ozbiljnu bolest pluća.

fun.en: Boron carbide armour is used in bulletproof vests — nearly as hard as diamond.
fun.hr: Oklop od bor-karbida koristi se u neprobojnim prslucima — gotovo je tvrd kao dijamant.

fun.en: Diamond and graphite are both pure carbon, yet completely different — carbon-14 also enables radiocarbon dating of ancient artefacts.
fun.hr: Dijamant i grafit oba su čisti ugljik, ali potpuno različiti — ugljik-14 omogućuje radiokarbonsko datiranje drevnih artefakata.

fun.en: Makes up 78% of Earth's atmosphere, yet plants can't use it directly — they need bacteria to 'fix' it into ammonia.
fun.hr: Čini 78% Zemljine atmosfere, ali ga biljke ne mogu koristiti izravno — trebaju bakterije za fiksaciju dušika u amonijak.

fun.en: Liquid oxygen is pale blue, not colourless — and it is strongly attracted to magnets.
fun.hr: Tekući kisik je blijedoplav, ne bezbojan — i snažno se privlači magnetima.

fun.en: Most electronegative element of all — fluorine corrodes glass and even some noble metals.
fun.hr: Najelektronegativniji element — fluor nagriza staklo i neke plemenite metale.

fun.en: Neon itself is colourless — different gases give different colours to so-called 'neon' lights.
fun.hr: Neon je sam po sebi bezbojan — različiti plinovi daju različite boje tzv. 'neonskim' svjetlima.

fun.en: Burns with an intense yellow flame — sodium vapour streetlights work by the same emission.
fun.hr: Gori intenzivno žutim plamenom — natrijeve uličke svjetiljke rade na istom principu emisije.

fun.en: Burns with blinding white light — magnesium fires cannot be extinguished with water; it reacts violently.
fun.hr: Gori zasljepljujućim bijelim svjetlom — vatru magnezija ne možete ugasiti vodom jer nasilno reagira.

fun.en: Once more valuable than gold — Napoleon served honoured guests with aluminium cutlery while others used silver.
fun.hr: Nekad vrjedniji od zlata — Napoleon je počasnim gostima posluživao aluminijskim priborom dok su ostali koristili srebrni.

fun.en: Silicon Valley is named after it — silicon chips power almost all modern computing.
fun.hr: Silikonska dolina nazvana je po njemu — silicijski čipovi pokreću gotovo sve moderno računalstvo.

fun.en: Discovered in 1669 by Hennig Brand, who evaporated urine — white phosphorus glows in the dark due to slow oxidation.
fun.hr: Otkrio ga 1669. Hennig Brand isparavanjem urina — bijeli fosfor sjaji u mraku zbog spore oksidacije.

fun.en: Used in vulcanising rubber — without sulfur treatment, rubber melts in summer and cracks in winter.
fun.hr: Koristi se za vulkanizaciju gume — bez tretmana sumporom guma bi se topila ljeti i pucala zimi.

fun.en: Chlorine gas was used as a chemical weapon in WWI — it is 2.5× denser than air and sinks into trenches.
fun.hr: Klorni plin korišten je kao kemijsko oružje u 1. svjetskom ratu — 2,5× gušći od zraka i tone u rovove.

fun.en: Fills incandescent light bulbs to prevent the tungsten filament from evaporating.
fun.hr: Puni žarne žarulje kako bi spriječio isparavanje volframove niti.

fun.en: Essential for nerve impulse transmission in all animals — a potassium imbalance can stop the heart.
fun.hr: Neophodan za prijenos živčanih impulsa u svim životinjama — neravnoteža kalija može zaustaviti srce.

fun.en: Most abundant metal in the human body — 99% is in bones and teeth as calcium phosphate.
fun.hr: Najzastupljeniji metal u ljudskom tijelu — 99% se nalazi u kostima i zubima kao kalcijev fosfat.

fun.en: Added in small amounts to aluminium alloys to make bicycle frames and baseball bats lighter and stronger.
fun.hr: Dodaje se u malim količinama aluminijevim legurama za lakše i čvršće biciklističke okvire i bejzbolske palice.

fun.en: As strong as steel but 45% lighter — used in aircraft, spacecraft, and medical implants due to its biocompatibility.
fun.hr: Jak kao čelik ali 45% lakši — koristi se u zrakoplovima, svemirskim letjelicama i medicinskim implantatima.

fun.en: Named after Vanadis, a Scandinavian goddess — vanadium steel is used in high-speed cutting tools.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Vanadis, skandinavskoj božici — vanadijev čelik koristi se u alatima za brzo rezanje.

fun.en: Anomalous config [Ar] 3d⁵ 4s¹ — half-filled d orbitals are extra stable. Chrome plating and ruby-red colour both come from chromium.
fun.hr: Anomalna konfiguracija [Ar] 3d⁵ 4s¹ — napola popunjene d orbitale su posebno stabilne. Kromiranje i rubinsko-crvena boja dolaze od kroma.

fun.en: Manganese nodules on the ocean floor are a vast, largely unmined mineral resource for the future.
fun.hr: Manganski noduli na dnu oceana golemi su, uglavnom neiskorišteni mineralni resurs budućnosti.

fun.en: Earth's core is largely solid iron — its slow solidification generates the magnetic field that deflects cosmic rays.
fun.hr: Zemljino jezgro je uglavnom čvrsto željezo — njegovo sporo skrućivanje stvara magnetsko polje koje odbija kozmičke zrake.

fun.en: Medieval miners called cobalt ore 'Kobold' (goblin) because smelting it released toxic arsenic fumes.
fun.hr: Medievalni rudari zvali su kobaltovu rudu 'Kobold' (goblin) jer je taljenje oslobađalo otrovne pare arsena.

fun.en: Named from German 'Nickel' (goblin) — miners thought the ore contained copper, but it didn't.
fun.hr: Ime dolazi od njemačkog 'Nickel' (goblin) — rudari su mislili da ruda sadrži bakar, ali nije.

fun.en: Anomalous config [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ — full d subshell is extra stable. The oldest metal used by humans, with artefacts over 10,000 years old.
fun.hr: Anomalna konfiguracija [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ — puna d podljuska je posebno stabilna. Najstariji metal koji su koristili ljudi, artefakti stari više od 10.000 godina.

fun.en: Galvanising (coating steel with zinc) prevents rust — zinc acts as a sacrificial anode, corroding instead of the iron.
fun.hr: Galvanizacija (prevlačenje čelika cinkom) sprječava rđanje — cink djeluje kao žrtvena anoda i korodira umjesto željeza.

fun.en: Melts at just 30 °C — you can melt gallium in the palm of your hand.
fun.hr: Tali se već pri 30 °C — galij možete stopiti u dlanu ruke.

fun.en: Predicted by Mendeleev in 1871 as 'eka-silicon' before its 1886 discovery — a triumph for the periodic table.
fun.hr: Predvidio ga Mendeleev 1871. kao 'eka-silicij' prije otkrića 1886. — trijumf periodičnog sustava.

fun.en: Victorian green wallpaper often contained arsenic pigments that slowly released toxic gas, poisoning entire families.
fun.hr: Viktorijanske zelene tapete često su sadržavale arsenove pigmente koji su polako otpuštali otrovni plin i trovali cijele obitelji.

fun.en: Its electrical conductivity increases dramatically in light — this property enabled the invention of the photocopier.
fun.hr: Električna vodljivost mu dramatično raste na svjetlu — ovo svojstvo omogućilo je izum fotokopirnog stroja.

fun.en: One of only two elements liquid at room temperature (the other is mercury) — its name comes from Greek for 'stench'.
fun.hr: Jedan od samo dva elementa tekuća na sobnoj temperaturi (drugi je živa) — ime dolazi od grčke riječi za 'smrad'.

fun.en: The SI metre was once defined by a specific number of krypton-86 wavelengths — before lasers took over.
fun.hr: SI metar je nekad bio definiran određenim brojem valnih duljina kriptona-86 — prije nego su laseri preuzeli tu ulogu.

fun.en: So reactive it ignites spontaneously in air and explodes violently on contact with water.
fun.hr: Toliko reaktivan da se spontano pali na zraku i nasilno eksplodira u kontaktu s vodom.

fun.en: Strontium salts give fireworks their brilliant crimson-red colour.
fun.hr: Soli stroncija daju vatrometu sjajnu karminski-crvenu boju.

fun.en: Yttrium aluminium garnet (YAG) crystals are used in surgical lasers and are the basis of most white LEDs.
fun.hr: Kristali itrij-aluminijevog granata (YAG) koriste se u kirurškim laserima i osnova su većine bijelih LED-ova.

fun.en: Used in nuclear reactor fuel rod cladding because it absorbs almost no neutrons — crucial for reactor efficiency.
fun.hr: Koristi se u oblozi gorivnih šipki nuklearnih reaktora jer gotovo uopće ne apsorbira neutrone — ključno za učinkovitost reaktora.

fun.en: Added to steel to make high-strength low-alloy (HSLA) steel used in pipelines, ships, and bridges worldwide.
fun.hr: Dodaje se čeliku za izradu visokorezistentnog niskolegirajućeg (HSLA) čelika koji se koristi u cjevovodima, brodovima i mostovima.

fun.en: Molybdenite (MoS₂) is used as a dry lubricant — it functions at extreme temperatures where oils break down.
fun.hr: Molibdenit (MoS₂) koristi se kao suhi lubrikant — funkcionira na ekstremnim temperaturama gdje ulja ne rade.

fun.en: First artificially produced element — all primordial technetium has decayed. Tc-99m is the most widely used medical radioisotope.
fun.hr: Prvi umjetno proizvedeni element — sav izvorni tehnecij se raspao. Tc-99m je najšire korišten medicinski radioizotop.

fun.en: Named after Ruthenia (Latin for Russia) — ruthenium is a key catalyst in the production of ammonia and acetic acid.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Rutheniji (latinski za Rusiju) — rutenij je ključni katalizator u proizvodnji amonijaka i octene kiseline.

fun.en: One of the rarest and most expensive elements — rhodium in catalytic converters reduces toxic NOₓ emissions from cars.
fun.hr: Jedan od najrjeđih i najskupljih elemenata — rodij u katalitičkim pretvornicima smanjuje otrovne NOₓ emisije automobila.

fun.en: Anomalous config [Kr] 4d¹⁰ — no 5s electrons at all. Palladium can absorb up to 900 times its own volume of hydrogen gas.
fun.hr: Anomalna konfiguracija [Kr] 4d¹⁰ — bez 5s elektrona. Paladij može apsorbirati do 900 puta svog volumena vodika.

fun.en: Highest electrical and thermal conductivity of all elements — silver iodide is used to seed clouds and induce rainfall.
fun.hr: Najveća električna i toplinska vodljivost od svih elemenata — srebrov jodid koristi se za 'sijanje' oblaka i indukciju kiše.

fun.en: Cadmium-nickel batteries powered early mobile phones and power tools — now largely replaced by lithium-ion due to cadmium's toxicity.
fun.hr: Kadmij-nikalne baterije napajale su rane mobilne telefone i alate — sada uglavnom zamijenjene litij-ionskima zbog toksičnosti kadmija.

fun.en: Indium tin oxide (ITO) coats every smartphone and tablet touchscreen — it is transparent and electrically conductive.
fun.hr: Indij-kositrov oksid (ITO) prevlači svaki zaslon pametnog telefona i tableta — proziran je i električno vodljiv.

fun.en: The Bronze Age was made possible by tin — alloyed with copper to produce bronze, far harder than either metal alone.
fun.hr: Brončano doba omogućio je kositar — legiran s bakrom daje broncu, mnogo tvrđu od oba metala zasebno.

fun.en: Used in antimony–lead alloys for car batteries — improves mechanical strength and reduces gassing during charging.
fun.hr: Koristi se u antimon-olovnim legurama za auto-baterije — poboljšava mehaničku čvrstoću i smanjuje plinovanje pri punjenju.

fun.en: Tellurium improves the machinability of steel — tiny additions let machine tools cut it far more easily.
fun.hr: Telurij poboljšava obradivost čelika — mali dodaci znatno olakšavaju obradu alatnim strojevima.

fun.en: Essential for thyroid hormone synthesis — iodine deficiency is the most common preventable cause of intellectual disability worldwide.
fun.hr: Neophodan za sintezu hormona štitnjače — nedostatak joda najčešći je preventabilni uzrok intelektualnih poteškoća u svijetu.

fun.en: Xenon anaesthesia produces surgical-depth anaesthesia with minimal organ toxicity — and it leaves the body completely unchanged.
fun.hr: Ksenonska anestezija postiže kiruršku dubinu anestezije uz minimalnu toksičnost za organe — i tijelo ga izlučuje potpuno nepromijenjenog.

fun.en: Caesium defines the SI second — one second is exactly 9,192,631,770 oscillations of a Cs-133 atom.
fun.hr: Cezij definira SI sekundu — jedna sekunda je točno 9.192.631.770 oscilacija atoma Cs-133.

fun.en: Patients swallow a 'barium meal' before X-rays — barium sulfate is so insoluble and X-ray opaque it outlines the digestive tract.
fun.hr: Pacijenti gutaju 'barijev obrok' prije rendgena — barijev sulfat je toliko netopljiv i neproziran za X-zrake da ocrtava probavni trakt.

fun.en: Used in high-refractive-index optical glass for camera and telescope lenses — lanthanum makes lenses sharper.
fun.hr: Koristi se u optičkom staklu visokog indeksa loma za leće fotoaparata i teleskopa — lantan čini leće oštrijima.

fun.en: Cerium oxide is used in automotive catalytic converters and in the glass of self-cleaning ovens.
fun.hr: Cerijev oksid koristi se u automobilskim katalitičkim pretvornicima i u staklu samočistećih peći.

fun.en: Praseodymium magnets (Nd–Pr–Fe–B) are used in hybrid car motors and wind turbine generators.
fun.hr: Praseodimijevi magneti (Nd–Pr–Fe–B) koriste se u motorima hibridnih automobila i generatorima vjetroturbina.

fun.en: Neodymium magnets are the strongest permanent magnets known — a small handful can lift a car.
fun.hr: Neodimijevi magneti najjači su trajni magneti poznati znanosti — mala šaka ih može podignuti automobil.

fun.en: Has no stable isotopes — all promethium on Earth is produced synthetically in nuclear reactors and decays away.
fun.hr: Nema stabilnih izotopa — sav prometij na Zemlji se sintetički proizvodi u nuklearnim reaktorima i zatim raspada.

fun.en: Samarium–cobalt magnets work at temperatures up to 300 °C where neodymium magnets lose their magnetism.
fun.hr: Samarij-kobaltni magneti rade na temperaturama do 300 °C gdje neodimijevi magneti gube magnetizam.

fun.en: Europium gives euro banknotes their red and blue fluorescence under UV light — a key anti-counterfeiting measure.
fun.hr: Europij daje eurobankovnicama crvenu i plavu fluorescenciju pod UV svjetlom — ključna mjera zaštite od krivotvorenja.

fun.en: Gadolinium contrast agents are injected before MRI scans — its seven unpaired electrons create an extremely strong magnetic signal.
fun.hr: Gadolinijeva kontrastna sredstva injektiraju se prije MRI skeniranja — sedam nesparenih elektrona stvaraju iznimno jak magnetski signal.

fun.en: Terbium activates the green phosphor in colour displays — it is why your screen can show bright green.
fun.hr: Terbij aktivira zeleni fosfor u prikaznicima u boji — zbog njega vaš zaslon može prikazivati jarko zelenu.

fun.en: Added to neodymium magnets to keep them working at high temperatures — critical for electric vehicle motors.
fun.hr: Dodaje se neodimijevim magnetima kako bi radili na visokim temperaturama — ključno za motore električnih vozila.

fun.en: Holmium has the highest magnetic moment of any element — used in the pole pieces of the strongest laboratory electromagnets.
fun.hr: Holmij ima najveći magnetski moment od svih elemenata — koristi se u polovima najsnažnijih laboratorijskih elektromagneta.

fun.en: Erbium-doped fibre amplifiers (EDFAs) boost signals in internet fibre-optic cables — they are why the global internet works at scale.
fun.hr: Pojačivači vlakana dopiranih erbijem (EDFA) pojačavaju signale u internet kabelima optičkih vlakana — zbog njih globalni internet funkcionira.

fun.en: Thulium-doped fibre lasers can cut through steel and are used in precision medical and industrial laser surgery.
fun.hr: Laseri optičkih vlakana dopiranih tulijem mogu rezati čelik i koriste se u preciznoj medicinskoj i industrijskoj laserskoj kirurgiji.

fun.en: Ytterbium atomic clocks are so precise they would drift by less than one second in 10 billion years.
fun.hr: Atomski satovi izerbijem toliko su precizni da bi se pomaknuli za manje od jedne sekunde u 10 milijardi godina.

fun.en: Lutetium oxyorthosilicate crystals in PET scanners convert gamma rays into light for medical imaging.
fun.hr: Kristali lutecijeva oksiortosilikita u PET skenerima pretvaraju gama zrake u svjetlost za medicinsko slikanje.

fun.en: Used in nuclear reactor control rods — hafnium absorbs neutrons so effectively it can shut down a reactor entirely.
fun.hr: Koristi se u kontrolnim šipkama nuklearnih reaktora — hafnij apsorbira neutrone toliko učinkovito da može potpuno ugasiti reaktor.

fun.en: Tantalum capacitors are inside every smartphone — they store charge in a tiny space and are essential for modern electronics.
fun.hr: Tantalski kondenzatori nalaze se u svakom pametnom telefonu — pohranjuju naboj u malom prostoru i ključni su za modernu elektroniku.

fun.en: Highest melting point of all elements — the filaments of old incandescent light bulbs were pure tungsten wire.
fun.hr: Najviša točka taljenja od svih elemenata — niti starih žarnih žarulja bile su od čistog volframskog žičanog vlakna.

fun.en: Rhenium jet engine turbine blades retain their strength above 1500 °C — crucial for modern high-performance aircraft.
fun.hr: Lopatice turbina mlaznih motora od renija zadržavaju čvrstoću iznad 1500 °C — ključno za moderne visokoučinkovite zrakoplove.

fun.en: Densest naturally occurring element — a cube of osmium the size of a sugar cube weighs about 450 g.
fun.hr: Najgušći prirodno prisutni element — kocka osmija veličine kocke šećera teži oko 450 g.

fun.en: Most corrosion-resistant metal — iridium survived the asteroid impact that killed the dinosaurs, leaving a thin global layer.
fun.hr: Najotporniji metal na koroziju — iridij je preživio udar asteroida koji je ubio dinosaure, ostavljajući tanki globalni sloj.

fun.en: Catalytic converters in cars contain platinum — it speeds up the conversion of CO and NOₓ into CO₂ and N₂.
fun.hr: Katalitički pretvornici u automobilima sadrže platinu — ubrzava pretvorbu CO i NOₓ u CO₂ i N₂.

fun.en: So unreactive it has been found unoxidised in ancient shipwrecks after centuries underwater — it never tarnishes.
fun.hr: Toliko nereaktivno da je pronađeno neoksidirano u starim brodolomima nakon stoljeća pod vodom — nikad ne gubi sjaj.

fun.en: The only metal liquid at room temperature — once used in barometers and thermometers; its vapour is highly toxic.
fun.hr: Jedini metal tekući na sobnoj temperaturi — nekad korišten u barometrima i termometrima; para mu je visoko otovna.

fun.en: Thallium poisoning mimics many other diseases, making it notoriously difficult to diagnose — it was once used as rat poison.
fun.hr: Trovanje talijem oponaša mnoge druge bolesti, što ga čini notorno teškim za dijagnostiku — nekad je korišten kao otrov za štakore.

fun.en: Romans used lead pipes and lead-lined wine vessels — centuries of low-level lead poisoning may have contributed to Rome's decline.
fun.hr: Rimljani su koristili olovne cijevi i posude za vino — stoljeća niskog trovanja olovom možda su pridonijela propasti Rima.

fun.en: Bismuth subsalicylate is the active ingredient in Pepto-Bismol — one of the few heavy metals safe enough to swallow.
fun.hr: Bizmut-subsalicilat aktivni je sastojak u Pepto-Bismolu — jedan od rijetkih teških metala dovoljno sigurnih za gutanje.

fun.en: Discovered by Marie Curie and named after Poland — polonium-210 is one of the most toxic substances known; lethal in nanogram quantities.
fun.hr: Otkrila ga Marie Curie i imenovala po Poljskoj — polonij-210 jedna je od najtoksičnijih poznatih tvari; smrtonosan u nanogramskim količinama.

fun.en: Rarest naturally occurring element — at any moment, less than 1 gram exists in all of Earth's crust combined.
fun.hr: Najrjeđi prirodno prisutni element — u bilo koje doba, manje od 1 grama postoji u cijeloj Zemljinoj kori zajedno.

fun.en: Second leading cause of lung cancer after smoking — radon seeps naturally from granite rocks into homes and accumulates in basements.
fun.hr: Drugi vodeći uzrok raka pluća nakon pušenja — radon prirodno procuri iz granitnih stijena u domove i nakuplja se u podrumima.

fun.en: So unstable that no pure sample has ever been observed — scientists have studied as few as 300,000 atoms at a time.
fun.hr: Toliko nestabilan da čisti uzorak nikad nije viđen — znanstvenici su proučavali svega 300.000 atoma odjednom.

fun.en: Marie Curie carried radium in her pocket and used it as a night light — she died of aplastic anaemia from radiation exposure.
fun.hr: Marie Curie nosila je radij u džepu i koristila ga kao noćno svjetlo — umrla je od aplastične anemije zbog izlaganja zračenju.

fun.en: Named from Greek 'aktinos' (ray) — actinium glows blue-white in the dark due to the intensity of its radioactive decay.
fun.hr: Ime dolazi od grčkog 'aktinos' (zrak) — aktinij sjaji plavičasto-bijelo u mraku zbog intenziteta svog radioaktivnog raspada.

fun.en: Three times more abundant than uranium — some countries are developing thorium reactors as a safer nuclear fuel alternative.
fun.hr: Tri puta zastupljeniji od urana — neke zemlje razvijaju torijeve reaktore kao sigurniju alternativu nuklearnom gorivu.

fun.en: One of the rarest naturally occurring elements — protactinium has no commercial applications due to extreme scarcity and radioactivity.
fun.hr: Jedan od najrjeđih prirodno prisutnih elemenata — protaktinij nema komercijalnih primjena zbog iznimne rijetkosti i radioaktivnosti.

fun.en: Uranium was used in glass to create yellow-green fluorescence under UV light — 'Vaseline glass' is still collected today.
fun.hr: Uran se koristio u staklu za žuto-zelenu fluorescenciju pod UV svjetlom — 'vazelin-staklo' se i danas skuplja.

fun.en: Named after the planet Neptune — discovered in 1940 at UC Berkeley, the first transuranic element produced artificially.
fun.hr: Imenovan po planetu Neptunu — otkriven 1940. na UC Berkeleyu, prvi transuranij element artificijalno proizveden.

fun.en: Pu-239 is the fissile material in nuclear weapons — only ~6 kg is needed to reach critical mass.
fun.hr: Pu-239 je fisijski materijal u nuklearnom oružju — potrebno je samo ~6 kg za dostizanje kritične mase.

fun.en: Tiny amounts of Am-241 in smoke detectors ionise air to detect smoke particles — a rare everyday use of a radioactive element.
fun.hr: Male količine Am-241 u detektorima dima ioniziraju zrak za detekciju čestica dima — rijetka svakodnevna primjena radioaktivnog elementa.

fun.en: Named after Marie and Pierre Curie — curium is so intensely radioactive that one gram generates about 3 watts of heat.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Mariji i Pierreu Curieju — kurij je toliko intenzivno radioaktivan da jedan gram generira oko 3 vata topline.

fun.en: Named after Berkeley, California — first synthesised in 1949 by Glenn Seaborg's team; produced only in microgram quantities.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Berkeleyu, Kalifornija — prvi put sintetiziran 1949. od strane tima Glenna Seaborga; producira se samo u mikrogramskim količinama.

fun.en: Californium-252 is used as a portable neutron source for detecting gold and silver ore and for treating certain cancers.
fun.hr: Kalifornij-252 koristi se kao prijenosni izvor neutrona za detekciju zlatnih i srebrnih ruda te liječenje određenih vrsta raka.

fun.en: Named after Albert Einstein — first found in the debris of the 1952 Ivy Mike hydrogen bomb test; only ever produced in tiny amounts.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Albertu Einsteinu — prvi put pronađen u ostatcima testa vodikove bombe Ivy Mike 1952.; nikad produciran u većim količinama.

fun.en: Named after Enrico Fermi — fermium has no practical uses; it has only been produced in picogram quantities.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Enricu Fermiju — fermij nema praktičnih primjena; produciran je samo u pikogramskim količinama.

fun.en: Named after Dmitri Mendeleev, creator of the periodic table — first synthesised in 1955 by bombarding einsteinium with alpha particles.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Dmitriju Mendelejevu, tvorcu periodičnog sustava — prvi put sintetiziran 1955. bombardiranjem ajnštajnija alfa česticama.

fun.en: Named after Alfred Nobel — its discovery was disputed between American and Soviet teams for years before IUPAC settled it.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Alfredu Nobelu — otkriće su godinama osporavali američki i sovjetski timovi dok ga IUPAC nije razriješio.

fun.en: Named after Ernest Lawrence, inventor of the cyclotron — the last actinide element and the final f-block element.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Ernestu Lawrenceu, izumitelju ciklotrona — zadnji aktinidni element i posljednji element f-bloka.

fun.en: Named after Ernest Rutherford — first transactinide element; produced one atom at a time by bombarding californium with carbon nuclei.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Ernestu Rutherfordu — prvi transaktinidni element; producira se atom po atom bombardiranjem kalifornija ugljičnim jezgrama.

fun.en: Named after Dubna, Russia — its discovery was long contested between American and Soviet teams (the 'Transfermium Wars').
fun.hr: Imenovan po Dubni, Rusija — otkriće je dugo osporavano između američkih i sovjetskih timova ('Transfermijevi ratovi').

fun.en: Named after Glenn Seaborg — the only person to have a chemical element named after them while still alive.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Glennu Seaborgu — jedina osoba po kojoj je kemijski element imenovan dok je još bila živa.

fun.en: Named after Niels Bohr — bohrium atoms last only seconds before decaying; its chemistry has barely been studied.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Nielsu Bohru — atomi borija traju samo sekunde prije raspada; njegova kemija jedva je proučavana.

fun.en: Named after Hesse (Hassia), Germany — only a handful of hassium atoms have ever been created in total.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Hessenu (Hassia), Njemačka — ukupno je ikad stvoreno tek nekoliko atoma hasija.

fun.en: Named after Lise Meitner, co-discoverer of nuclear fission — she was controversially overlooked for the Nobel Prize.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Lise Meitner, suotkrivačici nuklearne fisije — kontroverzno je bila zaobiđena pri dodjeli Nobelove nagrade.

fun.en: Named after Darmstadt, Germany — darmstadtium atoms exist for milliseconds; its only use is fundamental nuclear research.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Darmstadtu, Njemačka — atomi darmštatija postoje milisekunde; jedina mu je namjena temeljno nuklearno istraživanje.

fun.en: Named after Wilhelm Röntgen, discoverer of X-rays — relativistic effects are predicted to make roentgenium behave unlike its group 11 neighbours.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Wilhelmu Röntgenu, otkrivaču rendgenskih zraka — relativistički učinci predviđaju da će se rendgenij ponašati drugačije od svojih susjeda u skupini 11.

fun.en: Named after Nicolaus Copernicus — relativistic effects may make it behave as a gas at room temperature, unlike mercury below it.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Nikoli Koperniku — relativistički učinci mogu ga učiniti plinom na sobnoj temperaturi, za razliku od žive ispod njega.

fun.en: Named after Japan (Nihon) — first element discovered in Asia, synthesised at RIKEN in 2004; officially named in 2016.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Japanu (Nihon) — prvi element otkriven u Aziji, sintetiziran u RIKEN-u 2004.; službeno imenovan 2016.

fun.en: Named after Flerov Laboratory of Nuclear Reactions in Dubna — predicted to behave more like a noble gas than a metal due to relativistic effects.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Flerovljevom laboratoriju nuklearnih reakcija u Dubni — predviđa se da će se ponašati više kao plemeniti plin nego kao metal.

fun.en: Named after Moscow Oblast, home of JINR Dubna — only about 100 atoms of moscovium have ever been observed.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Moskovskoj oblasti, domovini JINR Dubna — promatrano je svega oko 100 atoma moskovija.

fun.en: Named after Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory — predicted to be a liquid metal at room temperature.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Nacionalnom laboratoriju Lawrence Livermore — predviđa se kao tekući metal na sobnoj temperaturi.

fun.en: Named after Tennessee (home of ORNL, Vanderbilt University, and UT) — only 4–5 atoms have ever been observed.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Tennesseeju (domovini ORNL-a, Vanderbilt sveučilišta i UT-a) — promatrano je samo 4–5 atoma.

fun.en: Named after Yuri Oganessian, a pioneer of superheavy element research — despite being in the noble gas group, it is predicted to be a solid.
fun.hr: Imenovan po Yuriju Oganessyanu, pioniru istraživanja superheavy elemenata — unatoč tome što je u skupini plemenitih plinova, predviđa se kao čvrsto tijelo.
